universal_law: EVERYTHING HAPPENING IS AN EVENT, AND ALL EVENTS HAVE INTENT

pipeline.name: EXISTING_ID_ACTIVATION
pipeline.rule: Prefer existing approved IDs. Do not create a new primitive merely because a new example exists.

pipeline.name: INTENT_RECORD_OPEN
pipeline.rule: Intent may start UNKNOWN/NOT_YET_DECODED and be refined as evidence, relations, actor views and parameters activate.

pipeline.name: LIVE_INTENT_SYNTHESIS
pipeline.rule: More relevant parameters may increase intent resolution; parameter count alone never justifies intent or confidence.

pipeline.name: PATTERN_CONTRIBUTION
pipeline.rule: Every Event contributes to pattern memory without automatic pattern promotion.

new_thought_test.pass_condition: A new Event activates existing primitives, relations and memories into a useful intent/pattern combination not explicitly supplied as a prior example, while preserving epistemic status and falsifiers.
new_thought_test.promotion_guard: Any new reusable primitive remains candidate until recurrence/behavioral distinction, evidence, falsifier, R-F-R and explicit review requirements are satisfied.

tablet_rule: The Egyptian tablet/artifact is the reconstruction Event. King profiles are parallel candidate actor-brain states used to generate and test who/when/why/how/for-whom/expected-future intent paths; profile count is not historical entity count.
rain_rule: Natural rain, pipe-generated falling water, children's perceived rain and resulting behavior are distinct linked Events. The father's agent intent, children's Actor View and physical water dynamics must not be collapsed into one event or one truth state.
